messages:
Nina H: Quick flag 1: a few invoke + structured-output docs are inconsistent after the recent rename. Some snippets return `{result: ...}` while schema examples expect the raw object. This breaks strict validators.

Carlos V: Oof. Which pages?

Nina H: Found it on /docs/guides/invoke/quickstart and /docs/reference/structured-output.md. Also the sample repo link on the quickstart points at a deleted branch.

Sophie L: Two small fixes: 1) update links to point at main branch, 2) add a migration note and a tiny parsing helper in the examples section: `const unbox = x => x?.result ?? x` (docs-only).

Carlos V: Agreed. I can open one PR that does link fixes, adds the unbox helper, and updates the schema examples to show both shapes.

Nina H: Can we also add a short parse hint so readers don't disable `additionalProperties: false`? E.g. show schema for raw object and a note: "If responses are enveloped, unbox before validation."

Alex M: Adding a quick test in the examples harness would help catch regressions. I'll add `examples/harness/test_unbox.js` that runs `unbox` over sample responses then validates via AJV.

redwood-docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1533 lint:queued, link-check:running

Carlos V: In the PR I'll also add an in-file comment near the unbox helper: `// compat shim for docs only; remove once snippets are updated (tracking: #1588)`. Keeps intent clear.

Nina H: Nice. Also please don't say "deprecated" for old helper names in user-facing text. Use "previous helper names" and include a short migration table.

Alex M: CI report: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness failed (one missing sample file). I'll patch the sample reference in the quickstart.

Carlos V: Fixed, pushed. Re-run CI.

redwood-docs-bot: CI results for PR #1533: link-check passed, lint passed, examples-harness passed. Ready to merge.

Sophie L: Reviewed, small wording nit about "compat shim" phrasing. Approving after nit.

Carlos V: Nit fixed. Merging now.

Alex M: Merged -> main. I'll create tracking issue #1588 and tentatively schedule a sweep in two weeks to remove the docs-only shim.

Nina H: Thanks all. I'll update the CHANGELOG/docs top note and close this thread.
